implemented: Introduced immutable asset-aware InstrumentRef, IntentEvent, OrderEvent, FillEvent and MarkEvent contracts with common IDs, UTC timestamps, source hashes and execution-fidelity labels.
Cash equity/ETF, futures and options require compatible contract fields; derivative quantities respect lot-size multiples.
Added deterministic canonical JSON event serialization and SHA-256 identity for cross-engine journal/transport use.
ForwardPaperSessionService now durably emits typed intent, order-state, fill and mark events from cash-equity paper reconciliation, with event-ID idempotency and conflict rejection.
Legacy schemas remain available so adoption can be incremental without breaking existing callers.
blockers: Existing OMS/accounting and futures/options engines have not all been migrated to consume the shared contract; cash PaperAccount remains the authoritative cash ledger and canonical events are currently a durable mirror.
Venue-specific contract metadata still requires sourced effective-date rules before executable orders can be accepted.
scope_note: This package establishes and validates the shared contract; it does not enable derivatives execution or replace existing ledgers.
